title: mokumesh mapping configuration
description: The calibration mokumesh saves and loads (ADR-0001 decision 7, shape from ADR-0002). Surfaces and masks are layers on a shared stage measured in pixels; the stage's extent is not stored but derived as the bounding box of every region's placement. Outputs are displays the Mac drives; each holds one or more regions, one per projector (ADR-0001 decision 6). A region shows its placement on the stage, keystoned by four corners. Version 1 files are still read and migrated to this shape.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. Raised when the shape changes incompatibly.

channel.description: The link channel the receiver checks in under (org.mokume-metal.mokumesh.<channel>).

layers.description: Surfaces and masks on the stage, drawn in order: earlier layers lie below later ones.

surface.description: Part of a stream, cut out by a quadrilateral and warped onto a quadrilateral on the stage.

id.description: A name that keeps pointing at this layer when the list is reordered (ADR-0003 decision 3). Unique among all layers. Optional: missing ids are assigned deterministically on load, and the app always writes them.

stream.description: The name of the stream this surface shows.

input.description: The part of the stream to cut out, normalized to 0–1 within the stream.

corners.description: Where the cut-out lands on the stage, in stage pixels.

mask.description: A polygon on the stage that blacks out the layers below it outside the polygon (inside when inverted).

id.description: A name that keeps pointing at this layer when the list is reordered (ADR-0003 decision 3). Unique among all layers. Optional: missing ids are assigned deterministically on load, and the app always writes them.

points.description: The polygon's vertices in stage pixels.

id.description: A name that keeps pointing at this output when the list is reordered (ADR-0003 decision 3). Unique among outputs. Optional: missing ids are assigned deterministically on load, and the app always writes them.

display.description: How to find the display. The id (CGDirectDisplayID) is tried first and the name second, because ids can change when displays are reconnected.

id.description: A name that keeps pointing at this region when the list is reordered (ADR-0003 decision 3). Unique among all regions, across outputs. Optional: missing ids are assigned deterministically on load, and the app always writes them.

rect.description: The part of the display this projector receives, normalized to the display's width and height (how a splitter divides it).

placement.description: The part of the stage this projector shows, in stage pixels.

keystone.description: Where the placement's top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left corners land, normalized within the region.

quad.description: Top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left corners. They must form a convex quadrilateral in that order.
